source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: E4 behavior
steps.body: E4 displays when water flows into the base pan and activates the overflow switch. Light indicator flashes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: IF WATER FLOWS INTO THE BASE AND ACTIVATES THE OVERFLOW SWITCH, THE DISHWASHER WILL DISPLAY E4.

steps.title: Detergent, level, and leak source
steps.body: Check detergent type/amount, appliance level, and visible leak at door gasket, sump, or hoses.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 1. CHECK THE USE OF THE DETERGENT.

steps.title: CN4 overflow switch
steps.body: Inspect CN4 overflow switch harness. Float down: CN4-2 to CN4-3 should read ≤3 Ω. Float up: open circuit.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect CN4 overflow switch harness. Float down: CN4-2 to CN4-3 should read ≤3 Ω. Float up: open circuit.

steps.title: Drain pan and pump
steps.body: Remove standing water from base. Does drain pump run and remove water when commanded in service mode?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove standing water from base. Does drain pump run and remove water when commanded in service mode?

steps.title: Locate leak
steps.body: With pan dry, run a short fill cycle and inspect sump, door seal, and hose clamps for leak source.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With pan dry, run a short fill cycle and inspect sump, door seal, and hose clamps for leak source.

steps.title: Drain pump bench test
steps.body: Run w11187658-drain-pump for 25–35 Ω winding check and check valve.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w11187658-drain-pump for 25–35 Ω winding check and check valve.

steps.title: Correct installation
steps.body: Reduce detergent, level unit, or repair identified leak source.
steps.oemOutcome: Reduce detergent, level unit, or repair identified leak source.

steps.title: Service drain path
steps.body: Replace drain pump or clear obstruction; dry base pan before retest.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace drain pump or clear obstruction; dry base pan before retest.

steps.title: Overflow path checked
steps.body: Pan dry, flood switch reset, drain verified — retest for E4.
steps.oemOutcome: Pan dry, flood switch reset, drain verified — retest for E4.
